sermon.title: Scriptural Evidence There was a Beginning Before Genesis — September 5, 2021
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer reviews the evidence for a beginning before Genesis 1 and that Christ is God in the flesh, then shows Christ is the same yesterday, today and forever: from Adam and Eve, Noah, Abraham and David to Acts 3, God comes to bless, warn and correct, and sends Christ to turn every one of us from our iniquities.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: The message begins at 30:52 after worship.

faqs.question: Why does calling Jesus God make people mad?
faqs.answer: Some want to keep Him only the Son of God.

faqs.question: Didn’t Enoch and Elijah ascend?
faqs.answer: Yes, but they were not conceived by God and born of a virgin.

faqs.question: What death were Adam and Eve warned of?
faqs.answer: A second death, separation from God.

faqs.question: Was Noah saved by works?
faqs.answer: He says Noah was saved by works of righteousness.

faqs.question: When did Job make his mistake?
faqs.answer: In his testing time, when he blamed God.

faqs.question: How did God correct Abraham through a pagan king?
faqs.answer: The king took Sarah, and God warned him not to touch her.

faqs.question: Can we serve God on our own strength?
faqs.answer: Too many try; God wants to touch and empower them.

faqs.question: Do I need to memorize songs to worship?
faqs.answer: No; just hallelujah and I love Jesus.
